info.name: Share Target
info.summary: Choose where a share lands in the recipient's files
info.description:
Share Target adds one field to the sharing sidebar: the path the share gets in the account of the recipient.
Nextcloud puts every incoming share in the share folder of the recipient, under the name of the file or folder. This app lets the sharer pick the path instead. A folder `Docs` sent to `Work/Client Files` shows as `Client Files` inside `Work`.
- The field shows for account shares and for group shares. - An administrator decides who may use it: everybody, or a list of accounts and groups. - The app can make the parent folder in the account of the recipient, and remove it again when the share goes and the folder is empty. Both switches are off by default. - Every path passes the same check in the browser and on the server: no traversal, no reserved name, no control character, no empty segment. - The recipient gets a notification that names the new path.
info.author: Martin
